design.ablations: remove access, logistics, control, beliefs, and organization ecology one at a time
design.cross_case: Nepal and Afghanistan only after the once-only frozen confrontation is authorized
design.mcse: report Monte Carlo standard errors with effective sample sizes
design.missingness: retain missing and negative observations; no favorable-case deletion
design.placebos: spatial adjacency permutation, timestamp shuffle, prior-only belief, random parent attribution
design.seed_panel: predeclared multi-seed panel; report all failures

limitations: Historical robustness is not executed under the current contract because the historical gate is closed.
The existing v5 historical logs are stale-core evidence and are not reused as current results.
A failed performance gate remains a deployment limitation, not a scientific null result.
